auth.about.account_1: You start with a lite account: post, comment and vote from day one, with no crypto setup at all.
auth.about.account_3: A few things need an account in your name: following people, editing your profile, and earning rewards directly.
auth.about.community_1: Likes, posts, comments: every move adds value to *our* world.
auth.about.community_2: We set the tone. No AI deciding what's cool. No engagement farms.
auth.about.mission_1: Put skate media back in skaters' hands. Forever.
auth.about.mission_2: Grow a real-deal global skate culture: raw, connected, and free AF.
auth.about.open_1: Anyone can fork this sh*t: skateshops, collectives, your homie with a laptop.
auth.about.open_2: Your content echoes across the skateverse. Powered by blockchain, owned by you.
auth.about.own_account_1: Post your first clip and the crew sponsors a Hive account in your name. Your keys reach you by email, and the app links them to your login for you.
auth.about.own_account_2: Nothing to buy, nothing to set up, no form to fill. Skate, post, and the account follows.
auth.about.own_account_3: Already have a Hive account? Use 'Sign in with Hive' on the login screen. The posting key is all it ever asks for.
auth.about.own_account_title: 🛹 Your own account, once you post
auth.about.tech_1: From VX tapes to IG clips, tech's always been part of the ride.
auth.about.tech_2: Skatehive is the next chapter: community-powered + crypto rewards = freedom.
auth.about.title: Skatehive Community
auth.about.what_1: It's a worldwide crew of skaters, creators, and weirdos doing it our way.
auth.about.what_2: Built on DIY, decentralization, and zero corporate bullsh*t.
auth.about.what_3: No bosses, no brands calling shots. This is 100% skater-owned, skater-run.
auth.about.why_1: Post-to-earn: film a trick, drop a story, share your vibe, get rewarded.
auth.about.why_2: Infinity Mag: our own never-ending skate mag. No ads. No fluff.
auth.about.why_3: Decentralized sponsorships: repping your crew, getting love from the people.

profile.hp.explain_other:
Hive Power is how much influence an account has on Hive.

The more someone holds, the more their votes are worth, so the posts they vote on earn more, and they earn more when others vote on theirs.

It grows by earning rewards on clips and keeping them as Hive Power instead of cashing out.
profile.hp.explain_own:
Hive Power is how much influence your account has on Hive.

The more you hold, the more your votes are worth, so the posts you vote on earn more, and so do you when others vote on yours.

You build it by earning rewards on your clips and keeping them as Hive Power instead of cashing out.
